caption: The drawing depicts a large, rounded stoneware jug with a narrow neck and a small, distinct lip at the top. The jug primarily appears in a greyish-brown tone with some shading to indicate light and surface texture. Near the neck, there is a decorative design consisting of three blue circles or linked rings each adorned with blue floral or leafy motifs. Below this decoration, the words “CONLAR’S BOOK” are inscribed into the surface of the jug. A brownish stain or discoloration is visible toward the lower right portion of the jug’s body. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller depiction of the same jug, angled to show a handle attached to the neck and shoulder area; this smaller image is rendered in similar tones and allows a more complete view of the jug's shape and structure. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
